_comment: Second half — run against the SAME session key while plan-continuation-initial's cp2 is still blocked on slow_tool. plan_followup=true: the starter writes this response at <plan_id>:followup:1 and signals the coordinator, which forwards it into the running PlanWorkflow. At the next checkpoint boundary foldInFollowups runs a PlanHandling turn there; it just answers (no re-plan). The point of the pair: the whole thing stays ONE task-run — RecordSkill's prefix-swept trajectory covers the planning turn, both checkpoint turns, AND this follow-up turn, and fires once.

message.content: While you're in there — make sure the evaluator caches a flag's value for the duration of a request so we're not hitting the config table per check.

scripted_model_responses.content: Good call. The evaluation hook resolves each flag once per request and memoises it on the request context, so repeated checks in the same request are free. No config-table round-trip after the first read.
